proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ F S hA hI hInd h0
  refine MeasureTheory.martingale_of_condExp_sub_eq_zero_nat hA hI fun i => ?_
  have h1 : Measurable (S (i + 1)) := ((hA (i + 1)).mono (F.le _)).measurable
  have h2 : Measurable (S i) := ((hA i).mono (F.le _)).measurable
  have hm : Measurable (S (i + 1) - S i) := h1.sub h2
  have hs : @MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable Ω ℝ _ (MeasurableSpace.comap (S (i + 1) - S i) inferInstance) (S (i + 1) - S i) :=
    (comap_measurable (S (i + 1) - S i)).stronglyMeasurable
  have := MeasureTheory.condExp_indep_eq hm.comap_le (F.le i) hs (hInd i)
  refine this.trans (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
  simpa using h0 i
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (F : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0) (S : ℕ → Ω → ℝ), MeasureTheory.StronglyAdapted F S → (∀ n, MeasureTheory.Integrable (S n) P) → (∀ n, ProbabilityTheory.Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap (S (n + 1) - S n) inferInstance) (F n) P) → (∀ n, ∫ ω, (S (n + 1) - S n) ω ∂P = 0) → MeasureTheory.Martingale S F P
